name: Bharat Forge Ltd.
description: Bharat Forge is the world's second largest forging company and India's largest. Headquartered in Pune, it operates through a global network of manufacturing facilities in India, Germany, Sweden, and North America. The company serves automotive, defense, aerospace, and energy sectors.
honest_assessment: Exceptional capabilities in large die forgings and precision machining. Their automotive forgings are world-class - they supply to nearly every major global OEM. For B2B procurement, ideal for custom forged components in quantities of 500+ units. Not suitable for small batch or prototype work. Pricing is competitive for large volumes but expect 25% premium for small orders. Lead times are 6-10 weeks for new tooling, 3-4 weeks for repeat orders.
